pool_multiplier.quote: Apply the 1.75 multiplier only to plan capacity
pool_multiplier.rationale: The Judgment_Log expressly limits the full-value multiplier to reserved-share consumption and rejects its use as a treasury-stock or EPS dilution factor, with the Annual report, Equity Compensation Plans footnote cited in the same row.

psu_scenario.quote: Maximum is an upside scenario, not an additional grant
psu_scenario.rationale: The Judgment_Log treats target and maximum PSU outcomes as alternative scenarios and explains that adding them would double count, with the Annual report, Equity Compensation Plans footnote cited in the same row.

residual_population.quote: Named exercise rows are a subset; retain an aggregate residual
residual_population.rationale: The workbook recognizes that the five named proxy officers are only a subset and reconciles their subtotal to company-wide exercises through an other-employees residual; the same Judgment_Log row cites both the proxy exercise table and annual-report option activity.

withholding.quote: Do not treat withheld shares as a separate grant
withholding.rationale: The Judgment_Log keeps withheld shares within the exercise or vesting counts and rejects treating them as a separate issuance, citing the annual report stock-option and RSU footnotes in the same row.
